# Latest Python Updates

This summary covers recent developments in the Python programming language.

Python 3.10 was released in October 2021 with pattern matching and other
improvements. More recently, Python 3.11 brought significant performance
gains, with some operations running up to 25% faster.

The Python Software Foundation announced the 3.12 release in October 2023,
which added even more optimizations. Many developers have migrated to these
newer versions to take advantage of the improvements.

Other sites report similar information about the current Python version,
with 3.12 being the most recent stable release as of early 2024.
